To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that
toremifene given at doses ranging 480–600 mg/day produces tumor concentrations that are high enough to reverse the multidrug resistance of lung tumors.
the optimal dose of the antiestrogens toremifene to reverse multidrug-resistance in patients with lung tumors is 480 mg for seven days.
the concentrations of toremifen and its metabolite, N-demethyltoremfene, were highest in lung tissues but the concentrations in tumor specimens were above the concentrations detected in serum.
